input: What happens to him now? I don't want him punished for more than he actually did.
draft:
Dellan Harrow's face reddened. "I shoved him. I didn't hit nobody. There's a difference."

Captain Doran Hale stood just inside the door, one hand resting on his belt. He looked at Dell, then at Nicco, then at the overturned cup still dripping off the counter's edge. His gaze held on Dell long enough for the dockworker to shift his weight and look at the floor.

Jessa Rook had already pulled a cloth and was wiping the counter. "He's been told to finish his drink and quiet down. That's where we were when you walked in."

Doran moved forward, not rushing. "Nobody's being hauled off tonight." He stopped an arm's length from Dell. "You knocked a man's drink over and put hands on him. That's the sort of thing that ends with you walking out of here on your own feet, or me walking you out. Which is it?"

Dell's jaw worked. His mug sat half-full on the table behind him. "I'll finish my drink."

"You'll finish it quietly, and then you'll go home." Doran's tone was level. He glanced at Nicco. "He spilled your drink. She'll pour you another. That settles what happened here unless you've got something else to say about it."
